Data Records The generated product 74 covers land surfaces between 70°N and 60°S from 2003 to 2023, freely available from https://cstr.cn/18406.11.Terre.tpdc.303150. It is organized by year and day. Namely, each file provides the global gapless daily mean LST for a single day, expressed in Kelvin and scaled by a factor of 100. Files follow the naming convention “YYYY_MM_DD_DMLST.tif”, where <YYYY>, <MM>, and <DD> denote the year, month, and day, respectively, and <DMLST> represents daily mean land surface temperature . The dataset is provided in GeoTIFF format with a spatial resolution of 1 km in sinusoidal projection. It can be accessed or processed using tools such as ENVI, ArcGIS, and Python. In addition , three types of pixel -level quality information can be accessed through https://github.com/Xiang-junhao/Gapless-Daily-Mean-LST-GEE. First, for each pixel -day, the average LST errors of the four instantaneous MODIS observations, the number of valid MODIS observations per day, and the validity of temporal upscaling (Step 1) are encoded into a single 16- bit unsigned integer (see Table 2 for the encoding scheme). Second, for each pixel-year, the EATC fitting error is provided as the RMSE between the input daily mean LSTs from Step 1 and their EATC-fitted values from Step 2. Third, an EATC fitting failure flag is provided for each pixel-year, with a value of 1 indicating a failed EATC fit in the corresponding year . The first two types of quality information can be generated globally for all study years using the accompanying GEE scripts (examples in Figure S3 and Figure S4).
